subject: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Proposal
overview: The committee reviewed and voted to refer a zoning update for the Salem Street corridor to the full City Council, which includes the creation of four new sub-districts and incentive-based height bonuses. The proposal establishes development standards for neighborhood compatibility and 'active frontage' while legalizing many existing non-conforming commercial uses.

items.title: 24-033 Zoning Ordinance Updates (Salem Street Corridor)
items.summary: Innes Associates presented a refined draft for the Salem Street corridor featuring multi-unit residential and mixed-use districts that utilize incentive zoning to offer extra height in exchange for community benefits like deeper affordability and public parking. The committee discussed neighborhood compatibility standards, parking ratios, and the potential for greater density on the Target lot before referring the matter to the City Council for a referral to the Community Development Board.
